fields.label: Access Mode
fields.help: The access mode of the disk.

fields.label: Create Snapshot Before Destroy
fields.help: If set to true, a snapshot of the disk will be created before it is destroyed.

fields.label: Create Snapshot Before Destroy Prefix
fields.help: This will set a custom name prefix for the snapshot that's created when the disk is deleted.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Image
fields.help: The image from which to initialize this disk.

fields.label: Licenses
fields.help: Any applicable license URI.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Name of the resource.

fields.label: Physical Block Size Bytes
fields.help: Physical block size of the persistent disk, in bytes.

fields.label: Provisioned Iops
fields.help: Indicates how many IOPS to provision for the disk.

fields.label: Provisioned Throughput
fields.help: Indicates how much throughput to provision for the disk.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: A reference to the region where the disk resides.

fields.label: Replica Zones
fields.help: URLs of the zones where the disk should be replicated to.

fields.label: Size
fields.help: Size of the persistent disk, specified in GB.

fields.label: Snapshot
fields.help: The source snapshot used to create this disk.

fields.label: Source Disk
fields.help: The source disk used to create this disk.

fields.label: Type
fields.help: URL of the disk type resource describing which disk type to use to create the disk.

fields.label: Async Primary Disk
Disk
fields.help: Primary disk for asynchronous disk replication.
A nested object resource.

fields.label: Disk Encryption Key
KMS Key Name
fields.help: The name of the encryption key that is stored in Google Cloud KMS.

fields.label: Raw Key
fields.help: Specifies a 256-bit customer-supplied encryption key, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.

fields.label: Rsa Encrypted Key
fields.help: Specifies an RFC 4648 base64 encoded, RSA-wrapped 2048-bit customer-supplied encryption key to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.
Encrypts the disk using a customer-supplied encryption key.

fields.label: Guest OS Features
Type
fields.help: The type of supported feature.
A list of features to enable on the guest operating system.

fields.label: Source Image Encryption Key
KMS Key Name
fields.help: The name of the encryption key that is stored in Google Cloud KMS.

fields.label: KMS Key Service Account
fields.help: The service account used for the encryption request for the given KMS key.

fields.label: Raw Key
fields.help: Specifies a 256-bit customer-supplied encryption key, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.

fields.label: Rsa Encrypted Key
fields.help: Specifies an RFC 4648 base64 encoded, RSA-wrapped 2048-bit customer-supplied encryption key to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.
The customer-supplied encryption key of the source image.

fields.label: Source Snapshot Encryption Key
Raw Key
fields.help: Specifies a 256-bit customer-supplied encryption key, encoded in RFC 4648 base64 to either encrypt or decrypt this resource.
The customer-supplied encryption key of the source snapshot.
